verdict.rationale: Published filing deadlines and penalty and interest schedules are a fair question for a state tax authority, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes showing HTTP 403 edge denials at www.ftb.ca.gov and webapp.ftb.ca.gov, and no page content was fetched. Nothing in the evidence shows deadlines or exact penalty and interest figures, so the verdict is none; confidence is low because this reflects inaccessibility rather than confirmed absence.
